title: The bird among the boxes
logline: The bird inside the garage, on Box 38's lid, in May, looking at the man's back at the table. The two unexplained things in one room: the bird and the work.

panels.composition: Inside the garage: the wall of numbered boxes, and on the lid of the thirty-eighth the rainbow bird, still, looking across the room at a man's back at the drafting table under the lamp.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, inside a garage studio a small rainbow bird perched on the lid of a numbered cardboard box in a wall of boxes looking across at a man's back at a drafting table under a lamp, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run

notes: The bird on the boxes, watching the back.
